Parakram Hackathon – Parakram Fest '26

Welcome to the flagship event of PARAKRAM FEST '26!

About The Hackathon:

PARAKRAM HACKATHON is a premier UP-level, offline hackathon designed to celebrate innovation, coding brilliance, and futuristic problem-solving. All registered teams must physically report to the SRIMT campus, Lucknow.

IMPORTANT NOTE: You must fill out our official Google Form to complete your registration. If you do not fill the Google Form, your team will not be allowed to participate.
OFFICIAL GOOGLE FORM LINK: [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScFQqaKRPrI8BHL2pPM9HckbQuiLV1ZTK4wEO7tNwNPEf-8BA/viewform]

Theme And Problem Areas:

  • AI Solutions
  • Sustainable Development
  • AI-Based Cybersecurity
  • Security and Safety

Eligibility And Rules:

  • Territory: Open ONLY to Engineering and Technical students from Uttar Pradesh (UP).
  • Team Size: 3 to 5 members per team.
  • Institute Limit: Maximum 4 teams per college.
  • Entry Fee: Absolutely FREE!
  • Mode: Purely offline (on-campus at SRIMT, Lucknow).

Mandatory Requirements For Event Day:

  • Valid College ID Card for all team members.
  • Laptops and essential chargers/hardware.

Perks For Participants:

  • Dedicated hacking slots equipped with extension boards, switches, and high-speed Wi-Fi.
  • Free snacks.
  • Trophies & Certificates for Winners.
  • Mentorship and networking opportunities with industry experts.

Venue: SR Institute of Management and Technology, NH-24, Sitapur Road, Bakshi Ka Talab, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

MPORTANT NOTE: You must fill out our official Google Form to complete your registration. If you do not fill the Google Form, your team will not be allowed to participate.
OFFICIAL GOOGLE FORM LINK: [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScFQqaKRPrI8BHL2pPM9HckbQuiLV1ZTK4wEO7tNwNPEf-8BA/viewform]
